payload.summary: Two dictionary sources need a browser read: RANZCP PPG #16 and the national recovery framework
payload.detail: Both publishers returned HTTP 403 to a direct fetch on 2026-09-16. RANZCP PPG #16 (rTMS administration) needs its identifier and last-updated month; sibling RANZCP pages responded and carry a 'Last updated' month in the same format. The national framework for recovery-oriented mental health services needs its title-page publisher and date, because the site index returns 2011 with a Victorian Department of Health attribution that conflicts with the recorded publisher. Neither may be resolved by picking whichever value is convenient.
